在仙音响起的瞬间，时笙就感觉自己原血复活了。

妈个鸡，要了本宝宝半条命。

系统那个小婊砸，竟然都不提醒一句。一个劲的让本宝宝买什么避雷针，它是算准了自己不会买吧？

绝逼是故意的！！

【宿主，是你自己不听我的话】怎么又是它的锅？没事它会出来吗？这宿主简直是不分青红皂白，它要换宿主！

“行，我不和你说这个。你说说，我渡劫这阵仗，是要弄死我吗？”叶清秋渡劫都没有她这么严重，怎么到她这儿就跟上了发条停不下来似的？

别说什么雷劫威力越大，后面前途无量。

就她自己那心境，她还不知道几斤几两，天道除非是想毁了这方世界，否则绝对不会给她开什么后门。

【宿主不是这个世界的人，本就不为天道所容，天道是在驱逐你。我只能在雷劫还未开始的提醒你，一旦雷劫开始，我就无法和你联系，这就是天道的力量。】

一个世界有一个世界的规则，如果它随意破坏，那么这个世界很容易就会崩塌。

时笙：“……”草你大爷！

【宿主……】系统迟疑了下，【你能告诉我，你是怎么扛过雷劫的吗？】

它当时都以为宿主会任务失败，已经准备好迎接宿主回归了。

谁知道宿主竟然扛过来了。

“想知道？”

【……想】

“我不告诉你。”

【……】它就知道是这样，回去它要给宿主来个360度的全身体检！

它就不信它查不出来宿主身上到底有什么BUG！

不但系统好奇时笙是怎么扛过的，就连凤辞都很好奇，他一开始还能感觉到她并不好受，但是很快那感觉就消失……

不过时笙不说，凤辞也不问，她在他身边就足够了。

渡劫成功后，只能在修真界停留一天，之后就会有接引之光出现，如果错过接引之光，那么就在也没办法去往仙界。

当然去了仙界之后还是可以下来的，这就像是必须在指定的时间去往仙界，将自己的身份信息让仙界记录下，这样以后才能自由出入仙界。

时笙渡完劫，叶清秋已经走了。

所以，杀叶清秋什么的，又特么落空了。

女主打反派的时候，觉得反派总是打不死的小强，可是打女主的时候，特么何尝不是同一个道理，都特么是打不死的小强。

“怎么没把她劈死？老天真是不开眼！”

“其实也不是一件坏事，至少她去祸害仙界了，不在祸害我们了，仙界那么多人，还怕她一个刚飞升的横？”

“你这么一说，也挺有道理的……可是万一她不待在仙界怎么办？”

“……”

乌鸦嘴！

The moment the fairy sound sounded, Shi Sheng felt that his original blood was resurrected.

Damn you, you took half of my baby's life.

That little bitch in the system didn't even give a warning.I kept asking my baby to buy a lightning rod, but he was sure that he wouldn't buy it, right?

It’s absolutely on purpose!!

[Host, it’s you who didn’t listen to me] Why is it the fault again?Will it come out okay?This host is simply indiscriminate, it wants to change hosts!

"Okay, I won't tell you this. Tell me, are you going to kill me in this battle to overcome the tribulation?" Ye Qingqiu's tribulation was not as serious as hers, so how come he couldn't stop like clockwork when he got here?

Don't say that the more powerful the thunder tribulation is, the brighter the future will be.

In her own state of mind, she still didn't know how much it cost. Unless Heaven wanted to destroy this world, he would never open any back door for her.

[The host is not from this world and is not tolerated by Heaven. Heaven is expelling you.I can only remind you before the thunder tribulation has begun. Once the thunder tribulation begins, I will not be able to contact you. This is the power of heaven.】

A world has its own rules. If they are broken at will, the world will easily collapse.

Shi Sheng: "..." Fuck you!

[Host...] The system hesitated for a moment, [Can you tell me how you withstood the thunderstorm?】

At that time, it thought that the host would fail the mission and was ready to welcome the host's return.

Who knew that the host could actually carry it over.

"Want to know?"

【...Think】

"I won't tell you."

[...] It knows this is the case, and it will give the host a 360-degree physical examination when it returns!

It doesn't believe that it can't find out what kind of bug there is in the host!

Not only was the system curious about how Shi Sheng survived, but Feng Ci was also curious. At first, he could feel that she was not feeling well, but the feeling soon disappeared...

But Shi Sheng didn't say anything, and Feng Ci didn't ask. It was enough for her to be by his side.

After successfully overcoming the tribulation, you can only stay in the world of cultivation for one day, and then the light of guidance will appear. If you miss the light of guidance, you will not be able to go to the fairy world.

Of course, you can still come back after going to the fairy world. This is like having to go to the fairy world at a designated time and let the fairy world record your identity information, so that you can freely enter and leave the fairy world in the future.

When Shi Sheng finished the catastrophe, Ye Qingqiu was gone.

Therefore, killing Ye Qingqiu was a complete failure.

When the heroine fights the villain, she thinks that the villain is always a weakling who cannot be killed. But when she fights the heroine, it is the same reason. They are all weaklings who cannot be killed.

"Why didn't you chop her to death? God is so blind!"

"Actually, it's not a bad thing. At least she has gone to harm the fairy world and no longer harms us. There are so many people in the fairy world, why are they afraid of her who has just ascended?"

"What you said makes sense...but what if she doesn't stay in the fairy world?"

"..."

Crow's mouth!
